title: docs(releases): state 18.0.0 as the v18 GA release, so the GA Version Packages PR renders
body:
Fixes #24569

Clause-②: no

The v18 GA release prose for the two release-owned pages that refuse the GA Version Packages PR. This PR pairs with PR #24555, which exits Changesets pre mode. With both applied, the `version-pr` lane's Render, Validate and Restore steps all exit 0 and the lockstep group renders `18.0.0`. **Draft, for the maintainer to merge.**

**Merge order:** PR #24555 first, this PR second, then one Version Packages refresh.

⛔ Nothing was published or tagged. No release workflow was dispatched. The Version Packages PR (#24524) and `changeset-release/main` were not touched. The dry-run ran in a scratch clone outside the worktree, and nothing from it was committed or pushed. No gate or rewriter changed.

Head `b174b74605` is `ba4afcc239` (`origin/main`, merged in before opening) plus two docs commits. The worktree's base was `04669a467e`.

## The change (docs only, `content/docs/releases/` only)

### `content/docs/releases/index.mdx`

1. The v18 entry's trailing status is now in the one shape `sync-release-index-currency` rewrites (`STATUS_SHAPE`):

   ```text
   before: (prerelease: `18.0.0-next.N` on npm's `next` tag, no GA date)
   after:  (current series: 18.0.0, released 2026-10-19)
   ```

   The prose before the status now reads: "its breaking changes landed in stages through the `18.0.0-next.N` prereleases on npm's `next` tag, each with its own changeset and migration, and its GA release, 18.0.0, publishes to npm's `latest` tag and moves it from 17.x to 18".
2. The paragraph "**The v18 line is a major in prerelease.** …" (old lines 58-62) is now "**The v18 line is a major, and 18.0.0 is its GA release.**" The pre-mode regime is in the past tense, and the paragraph states the exited state: the 18.0.0 cut publishes to `latest`, and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` again fails a pull request that declares a major bump. The wording follows PR #24555's edit of `backward-compatibility.mdx`.

### `content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx`

1. The `description` front matter is now: "The v18 line and its GA release, 18.0.0, which closes the `18.0.0-next.N` prerelease train and publishes to npm's `latest` tag. …"
2. The release-status blockquote, in full:

   ```md
   > **Release status: 18.0.0 is GA — the release this page documents.** It
   > closes the v18 prerelease train, which published as `18.0.0-next.N` on npm's
   > `next` dist-tag. The 18.0.0 cut leaves Changesets pre mode, so the
   > `@objectstack/*` packages stop publishing as `18.0.0-next.N`, and 18.0.0
   > publishes to npm's `latest` dist-tag, which moves from 17.x to 18 with it. A
   > `^17` dependency range still never moves to 18 by itself: move every
   > `@objectstack/*` dependency to 18 together, and read
   > [Upgrading](/docs/upgrading) before you do.
   ```

3. The two pre-mode bullets are rewritten. "Through `next` before `latest`" (old `:27`) is now in the past tense and ends with "18.0.0 is the cut that takes the line to `latest`". "GA ends the prerelease" (old `:62`) is now "**18.0.0 ends the prerelease.** It is the GA cut: it leaves pre mode and publishes the line to `latest`." The "Curated notes … are not written yet" sentence is kept verbatim.
4. One more sentence, of the same class and in the same file (second commit `b174b74605`): "While the line is open, every other breaking change that lands on `main` ships on it too" is now in the past tense. That sentence stops being true once the guard fails a major bump again.

Every heading and anchor is unchanged. In particular `## How a breaking stage lands on this line` stays as it is: its anchor is linked from the release index and five times from `protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx`.

### Why the text is worded this way

- **The status shape.** `(current series: X.Y.Z, released YYYY-MM-DD)` is the only shape the rewriter rewrites, so the 18.1.0 version pass will stamp the next minor without a person. A probe of the rewriter's own functions on this text: `rewriteStatusField(field, '18.0.0', …)` returns `null`, meaning it leaves a field that already names the newest GA alone, date included. `rewriteStatusField(field, '18.1.0', '2026-11-01')` returns `current series: 18.1.0, released 2026-11-01`.
- **The blockquote's assertion.** It uses "18.0.0 is GA", one of the forms `releasedAssertionRe` accepts. It contains none of the six `PAGE_STALE_SIGNALS`. Probed with the gate's own predicates: `pageStatusProblems(18)` returns `[]`, `indexStatusProblems(18)` returns `[]` and `indexCurrencyFindings(18, '18.0.0')` returns `[]`. The control on the base text: 1 page problem, the index signals `prerelease-word` and `prerelease-version`, and 1 currency finding.
- **True on both sides of the publish.** Nothing here says that npm already serves 18.0.0 on `latest`, or that "a plain install now resolves 18.0.0". 18.0.0 is described as the release the page documents and by what it does: it "publishes to npm's `latest` dist-tag". That stays true for a reader on `main` between this merge and the publish, and after the publish. The one dated claim is the index status, discussed next.

## DATE

`released 2026-10-19` is the UTC day this PR is opened.
- No gate checks the date, re-measured: `indexCurrencyFindings` judges the version only, and `check:release-page-status`'s index matcher judges only the prerelease signals.
- The rewriter never re-dates a field that already names the newest GA. The dry-run below printed "every in-scope entry … (v16, v17, v18) already names the newest GA release of its major … nothing rewritten", and the date came through the version pass unchanged.
- So nothing corrects the date later. **If the maintainer merges on a later day, the seat re-dates it in this PR before the merge.**

## Proof: the paired dry-run (scratch clone, never pushed)

Setup:
- A clone of `/home/user/objectstack` at a short scratch path, with the push URL set to an invalid path.
- Full history (`--is-shallow-repository` false). Local `main` is `ba4afcc239`.
- Branch `rehearsal2` = this PR's head `b174b74605` merged with PR #24555's head `abec338235`, giving merge `468a6ad229`. That tree differs from `main` in exactly the 4 files of the two PRs, and `.changeset/pre.json` reads `mode: "exit"`.
- `release-rehearsal-clone.mjs` reported "✓ FIT". `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` ran with its scripts this time, since the short path stays under tsx's IPC socket limit.
- The three `version-pr` steps were **extracted verbatim from `release.yml`** with a YAML parser. The blob `47db41eeea` is the same in the clone and on `main`. They ran under `bash -e` with `RUNNER_TEMP`, `GITHUB_OUTPUT` and `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` pointed at scratch files, each under `os-verify-lock.sh`.

| step | exit | reading |
|---|---|---|
| Render the post-version tree | **0** | `pending_before=1029`, 1205 paths moved. `sync-release-index-currency`: "(v16, v17, v18) already names the newest GA release … nothing rewritten". `check-skill-compatibility-version --fix`: 10 of 10 SKILL.md stamps moved to `18.0.0`. |
| Validate the post-version tree | **0** | "Post-version tree validated.", with 15 of 15 content gates green, `check:release-page-status` and `check:release-index-currency-sync` among them. "1205 path(s), all inside the reviewed shape", "major-boundary surfaces left unvalidated: 0". |
| Restore the pre-version tree | **0** | "Pre-version tree restored: 1029 pending changeset(s), working tree clean." |

Rendered versions:
- `@objectstack/spec` is **`18.0.0`**.
- The fixed group reads 73 of 73 members at `18.0.0`.
- `.changeset/pre.json` was deleted by the pass.
- The index status survived the pass byte-identical: `(current series: 18.0.0, released 2026-10-19)`.

The first round on head `3754bbeddb`, before commit 2, gave the same three exit codes and the same readings.

NOT MEASURED: the read-rehearsal steps (`changesets/action`), because that is a GitHub Action.

## This PR alone on `main` (still `mode: "pre"`)

It may sit on `main` briefly before or after #24555, so every docs gate was run on this branch's own head (`b174b74605`, `.changeset/pre.json` at `mode: "pre"`). Exit codes were captured before any pipe.
- **Derived families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives **47** commands for the two-file diff, and all 47 exit 0. The `--ran` reconciliation reads "47 derived, 47 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 47 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". On the first pass, five families (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:docs`, `check:skill-examples` and `check:docs-transcript-drift`) returned a PREREQUISITE refusal (exit 3, or exit 1 "Generate it first"). I built `@objectstack/spec` plus the `@objectstack/lint...` closure, and the `@objectstack/client-react...` closure, under `os-verify-lock.sh`, then re-ran all 47.
- **Release-docs gates beyond the derivation, all exit 0:** `check:release-index-currency-sync`, `node scripts/sync-release-index-currency.mjs` (wrote nothing; the tree stayed clean), `check:docs-image-tag`, `check:docs-image-tag-sync`, `check:release-page-status`, `check-release-section-coverage.mjs --strict` and `check:release-notes`. On `main` the CHANGELOG has no `## 18.0.0` heading yet, so the v18 entry is not in those gates' GA scope. The text is green there for that reason, and green on the post-version tree as shown above.
- **Control bytes:** the self-scan finds none in either file.

## Changeset and label

There is no changeset, because nothing here publishes. Neither file is reachable from any public package's `files[]`: 73 public packages, none of whose `files[]` entries names `content`, `docs` or `releases` or climbs out of its package. The positive control is that 73 of 73 name `dist`. So `skip-changeset` rides the create.

## Acceptance notes

- **After the GA publishes, the release-coverage patrol reports the v18 page.** Validate's advisory `check-release-section-coverage` already reports it on the post-version tree: "NO heading on this page names the 18.0 series". It is advisory in Validate and green there. The nightly `release-coverage-patrol.yml` runs `--strict` and records it on its anchor issue until the curated 18.0.0 notes are compiled. That compile is the release-time step the page itself names ("Curated notes … are compiled at release time"), as with every 17.x minor. Writing a heading only to satisfy the patrol would be a heading with no notes under it. Noted, not carded.
- **Bullets 2-4 of "How a breaking stage lands on this line" are still in the present tense** ("ADR-0131 lands in stages", "Protocol 18 comes with it", "The AI skills move with the packages"). None of them states the pre-mode regime, and none is made false by the exit. Turning the section into the line's history belongs to the curated 18.0.0 notes. Noted only.
- **The index link text stays `[v18]`.** GA lines use `[v17.0.0]`-style text, but no gate reads link text and the card did not ask for it. Noted only.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:只改了两页发布文档，都在 `content/docs/releases/` 下。
- 发布索引里 v18 条目的状态从"预发布、没有 GA 日期"改为 `(current series: 18.0.0, released 2026-10-19)`。这是版本步骤的改写器唯一能识别、以后能自动更新的格式。同一页的"v18 正在预发布"段落改成已退出预发布的说法。
- v18 发布页的 `description`、发布状态引用块，以及三句预发布模式下的现在时句子，改为"18.0.0 是 GA 版本，发布到 npm 的 `latest`"。
- 没有改任何代码、门禁、改写器或 changeset。

**为什么改**:PR #24555 退出预发布模式后，版本 PR 的刷新会在这两处按设计拒绝:Render 卡在 `sync-release-index-currency`,Validate 卡在 `check:release-page-status`。在临时克隆里同时套上 #24555 和本 PR,原样重放 `release.yml` 的 Render / Validate / Restore 三步：退出码都是 0,15 个内容门禁全绿,`@objectstack/spec` 渲染为 `18.0.0`,73 个锁步包全部是 `18.0.0`。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:
- 措辞在 npm 发布前后都成立：没有写"npm 已经在 `latest` 上提供 18.0.0",只写 18.0.0 是本页记录的 GA 版本，它会发布到 `latest`。唯一带日期的说法是索引里的 `released 2026-10-19`。
- 日期没有门禁校验，改写器也不会改它。如果合并不在 2026-10-19(UTC),席位会在合并前在本 PR 里改成合并当天的日期。
- 本 PR 单独留在 `main` 上(仍是 `mode: "pre"`)时，派生出的 47 个门禁全部为 0,其余发布文档门禁也全绿。
- 顺序反了的代价：如果本 PR 先于 #24555 合并,`main` 上会短暂出现"已退出预发布模式"的文字，但当时仍处于预发布模式。门禁不会变红。
- GA 发布后，夜间的 release-coverage patrol 会报告 v18 页还没有 18.0 的小节标题，直到整理好的 18.0.0 发布说明写完。这和每个 17.x 小版本的流程一样。
- 回滚:GA 版本 PR 合并前，直接 revert 本 PR 即可。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:
1. 选定 GA 当天先合并 PR #24555,再合并本 PR,然后触发一次版本 PR 刷新。
2. 确认刷新后版本 PR 的 head 里 `@objectstack/spec` 是 `18.0.0`,再按发布流程合并版本 PR 并批准发布。
3. 如果合并日期不是 2026-10-19,先让席位改日期再合并。
